title: XOR Queries of a Subarray
summary: Given an array of positive integers and a series of query ranges, compute the XOR of elements within each specified range.
statement: Given an array of positive integers and a series of query ranges, compute the XOR of elements within each specified range. Return an array of results corresponding to each query.
constraints: Return one XOR result per query in input order.
hints: Prefix XOR through index i cancels shared prefixes just like prefix sums.
Build prefix[0]=0 and append prefix[-1] XOR value.
Every element before l appears twice and cancels; each queried element appears once.
editorial: Every element before l appears twice and cancels; each queried element appears once.

tests.explanation: The four requested subarray XOR values are returned in order.
